## Purpose

Describe the problem and the bounded change.

## Contracts and compatibility

List affected schemas, clients, repositories, or deployment surfaces.

## Safety review

- [ ] No credentials, personal data, live location, or active-case material
- [ ] Security and privacy consequences reviewed
- [ ] Accessibility and operational failure modes reviewed
- [ ] Tests or verification evidence included

## Salvage check

If this PR supersedes or replaces an older one, say which, and name at least one
concrete thing carried forward from it (a test, a fixture, an error message, a
pin, a doc paragraph). See [`docs/pr-salvage-policy.md`](../docs/pr-salvage-policy.md).

- [ ] Supersedes nothing, **or** the salvaged item is named above.
